candidates.tagline: Bloomington paid $95K for a logo that looks like a butt
candidates.story: Bloomington, Indiana hired a Colorado agency for $95,000 to rebrand the city and got back a stylized 'B' that residents and council members immediately agreed looks exactly like a pair of buttocks.
candidates.why_funny: Nothing says 'we thought deeply about our civic identity' like six figures spent on a logo that looks like someone bent over.
candidates.alt: The proposed new Bloomington city logo, a geometric stylized capital B, annotated with the satirical label 'Great place to fart'

candidates.tagline: $2,300 robot legs so you can go hiking with your actual legs off-duty
candidates.story: Hypershell debuted the Halo at IFA Berlin 2026 — a $2,300 full-leg consumer exoskeleton with four AI-controlled motors that straps to your hips and knees so you can hike without your knees noticing.
candidates.why_funny: The solution to having legs that get tired on hills is apparently to buy a second, robotic pair of legs for the price of a used car.
candidates.alt: A hiker outdoors wearing the Hypershell Halo full-leg exoskeleton, with carbon-fiber motorised modules clamped to both hips and knees
